title: How Does Your Body Feel Today?
caption: Migraine-prone today, and lights may feel a bit too bright. Signals look mostly steady, still a small tug can tip some from okay to not-okay. Keep shades or a cap handy, soften glare indoors, and pace your to-dos with short breaks and slow breathing.

affects: Migraine and headache sensitivity may rise a bit for some. You might notice faster eye strain, temple tightness, or a quicker jump from okay to not-okay. Sensory load like bright stores or sharp sounds can stack more quickly. The effect is more about lower thresholds than a major spike.
playbook:

- Hydrate and space out screen blocks

- Keep plans flexible around peak triggers

fb.caption:
How Does Your Body Feel Today? Migraine-prone is the lane, and lights may feel a bit too bright even before the day really ramps up. Signals look mostly steady; still, for some people a small nudge—glare, a sharp sound, a busy aisle—can flip you from okay to not-okay faster than usual.

Today’s backdrop is quiet overall: geomagnetic conditions are calm with a southward magnetic tilt, solar wind looks normal, no new flares, and the CMEs on the boards aren’t pointed at Earth. Schumann resonance sits near baseline. The body read is about lower thresholds rather than a big spike, so think less “storm” and more “easier to overload.” Practical move: wear sunglasses or a cap outside, dim overheads and reduce screen glare, and drink water regularly to take pressure off the system. Try screen blocks in smaller chunks with a minute in a darker corner when you feel the first temple tug—catching it early can keep the day from snowballing. Keep timing flexible around your known triggers.
